name: Harmonic
description: Harmonic lets agents search companies, people, and investors and read their funding and headcount data with the signed-in Harmonic account. Each user signs in to their own Harmonic account through the browser.

prompts.text: Find seed-stage climate startups in Europe that raised in the last six months.
Summarize the funding history and headcount growth of Acme Robotics.
Who are the founders of Acme Robotics and where did they work before?

apps.name: Harmonic
apps.description: Company, people, and investor search, over Harmonic's MCP server with browser sign-in.
